summary: Iteration 9 — tested the 3 new features (change-password, ticket attachments, admin canned replies) end-to-end. Backend: /app/tests/smoke_tickets_pw.py passes (password change validation, upload 400 for text/plain, /api/files/{path} returns 404 for ticket uploads, /api/tickets/files/{path} auth checks: owner 200, no-auth 401, unrelated buyer 403, admin 200, message creation blocked for unrelated buyer 404, canned CRUD + role gating OK, admin attach + buyer can fetch it 200). Frontend (public URL on wallet-goods.preview.emergentagent.com, viewport 1440x900): (1) Account page row data-testid=account-change-password opens change-password-dialog with cp-current/new/confirm inputs; typing different confirm shows cp-mismatch and disables cp-submit; cp-toggle-show flips input type from password→text; submitting wrong current password surfaces an error toast and dialog stays open; submitting correct creds closes dialog and new password works on next login (freshly registered buyer, admin/buyer/vendor demo passwords untouched). (2) Support /support?new=1 new-ticket-form shows new-ticket-attach-btn + hidden new-ticket-attach-btn-input; attaching a PNG renders thumbnail inside attach-preview with attachment-remove-<id>; submitting creates ticket and first message shows ticket-attachment-<id> thumbnail, clicking opens attachment-viewer dialog with full image. (3) Ticket reply box ticket-attach-btn/ticket-attach-btn-input accepts image-only reply (ticket-reply-send not disabled with empty text + 1 image) and server stores it; the attachment appears as a new ticket-attachment-<id> block. (4) Admin panel → admin-tab-tickets, admin-tickets-search finds the ticket by subject; opening the thread shows quick-replies-btn, dropdown quick-replies-menu lists exactly quick-reply-0..4 (Deposit delay / Need TXID / Wrong network / Key not working / Resolved); clicking quick-reply-0 inserts text into ticket-reply-input with {name}→'TEST Buyer2' and {ref}→'TCK-BABE6E'; quick-replies-manage opens canned-manage-dialog with 5 canned-row-i, canned-title-i/canned-text-i/canned-delete-i, canned-add adds a 6th row, canned-save persists (reload shows 6 rows with TEST_tmp as last). Restored the 5 defaults after test (deleted TEST_tmp + saved). (5) Admin attach PNG via ticket-attach-btn-input in reply box + text 'Admin reply with proof' delivers successfully; buyer re-logs in on /support, opens the same ticket and sees 3 ticket-attachment-<id> thumbnails incl. the admin one labelled 'Support team', clicking opens attachment-viewer with the admin image rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: Attachments.jsx uses an in-module Map `cache` keyed by path to cache object URLs returned from URL.createObjectURL. The URL is never revoked and the cache grows unbounded for the SPA lifetime; consider revoking old URLs or capping cache size. Minor memory nit, no functional bug.

ChangePassword.jsx native HTML5 validation uses required+minLength=8 but the mismatch state only disables submit after the user has typed something in confirm; cp-submit is still enabled while new/confirm are empty — relying on the browser's native 'required' popup. OK but consider also disabling cp-submit while any field is empty for consistency.

CannedReplies.jsx ManageDialog save() silently filters out rows with empty title OR empty text, meaning a user who adds a blank row + hits save loses that row with no feedback. Consider toasting a warning when rows are dropped, or disabling canned-save while any row is partially filled.

Attachments.useAttachments.add() aborts the whole batch on first upload failure but leaves earlier successful uploads attached — reasonable, but it also keeps `uploading=true` only inside try (fine). More importantly, the server rejects non-image mime types with 400 and the UI toasts errMsg(e) — verified good UX.

server.py ticket_file endpoint correctly scopes access to owner / admin / ticket participants; the public /api/files/{path} 404s for ticket uploads which protects user-uploaded screenshots from public enumeration — verified via smoke test. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids: account-change-password; change-password-dialog, cp-current-input, cp-new-input, cp-confirm-input, cp-toggle-show, cp-mismatch, cp-submit. new-ticket-attach-btn (+ -input), ticket-attach-btn (+ -input), attach-preview, attachment-remove-<id8>, ticket-attachment-<id8>, attachment-viewer. quick-replies-btn, quick-replies-menu, quick-reply-0..N, quick-replies-manage, canned-manage-dialog, canned-row-i, canned-title-i, canned-text-i, canned-delete-i, canned-add, canned-save. Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password body {current_password,new_password} 400 wrong current, 422 min 8 chars; POST /api/tickets/upload multipart file (image/* only) → {path}; GET /api/tickets/files/{path} requires auth + (uploader | admin | ticket member); GET /api/files/{path} returns 404 for ticket uploads (public bucket separate). /api/tickets accepts {attachments:[path,...]} and requires either non-empty message OR >=1 attachment. GET+PUT /api/admin/canned-replies admin-only. Message schema {message?, attachments?: [path]}, send is allowed with only attachments.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. All 3 features behave to spec.
